summary: reboot options: reboot_timeout (default 600s, applied separately to reboot and test so total can double), search_paths for shutdown, and test_command (whoami).
questions: How long does the reboot module wait for a host to come back?
How do I increase the reboot timeout for slow servers?
Which command is used to confirm the host is ready after reboot?
Where does reboot look for shutdown?

answer_card.title: reboot timeout and test
answer_card.answer_md:
- `reboot_timeout` (600s): applied separately to reboot verification and test command, so max ≈ 2x
- `search_paths` (`/sbin`, `/bin`, `/usr/sbin`, `/usr/bin`, `/usr/local/sbin`): only these are searched
- `test_command` (`whoami`)
